abstract: A unilateral ovarian teratoma was observed in a C3H/HeN breeder mouse. Tissues originating form the 3 embryonal germ layers were present in the tumor. A focus suggestive of epithelial malignant transformation was noted; however, neither metastasis nor invasion into the surrounding capsule was found.
abstract_ja: C3H/HeN繁殖マウスにおいて、片側の卵巣奇形腫が観察された。腫瘍には3つの胚葉すべてに由来する組織が認められた。上皮性悪性転化を示唆する病巣が認められたが、転移も周囲被膜への浸潤も認められなかった。
